subject: 5 ways to speed up your month-end close
body:
This week in FinOps Weekly:

1. Automate bank reconciliations with rules, not spreadsheets.
2. Close sub-ledgers on a fixed calendar.
3. Standardise accrual templates across teams.
4. Track open purchase orders weekly, not monthly.
5. Review vendor master changes with a second approver.
